description: No first-order theory in the one-relation language has exactly the nonempty strict well-orders as its models.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.wellOrders_not_axiomatizable :
  ¬∃ T,
      ∀ (M : Type) (x : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.language.Structure M),
        Nonempty M →
          (M ⊨ T ↔
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.WellOrdered
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.edge)
